_comment: Difficulty targets for the balance sim (tools/balance_sim.gd, BalanceCurve). Each case is one alert tier of an act (escalation, data/tuning/escalation.json, R2-B) at the defense level that tier's band puts a typical region of the act at, or the boss stub. A case plays runs auto-fights of a freshly drafted squad (BotFactory, run i drafts from seed base_seed + i) and checks the win rate against target [low, high] percent. factions: the act's factions (data/combat/factions.json regions), run i fights factions[i % size]; empty plays the generic roster (enemy_tables.json pools), as the boss stub does. The unit tier comes from the defense level through tier_by_act (the difficulty-curve switch in data/variants/variants.json). territory (default: act) picks the difficulty-curve scaling (DifficultyRules; boss is the boss stub's territory). skill_ranks_added: ranks added to every squad skill, a stand-in for the growth a squad has by then. TODO(decision: difficulty-targets): the bands (alert 0 60-70%, alert 1 52-62%, alert 2 45-55%, boss 30-40%), the levels per alert and the growth stand-ins are first guesses.
